This repository reduces those mechanis"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ms to two implementations that can be read, executed, and tested. It also includes an interactive tu"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"torial site generated from the source code."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Each implementation uses six independent deterministic examples with only the inputs and runtime eve"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nts needed for its questions. Each Step contains one model"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" request and its tool execution. The Harness builds a request from the current state.
